items.description:

items.name: Potion of Cure Serious Wounds
items.description: This spell functions like cure light wounds, except that it cures 3d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +15).

items.name: The Timestopper
items.description:
The tattoo grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Charisma of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the tattoo is worn.
The item also allows the bearer to add their charisma bonus to initiative checks.
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, Eagle's Splendor; Cost 2,500 gp

items.name: Supple, A Wine By Calvin Carpenter
items.description:
Calvin Carpenter's finest line of dry white wines, made from the finest potatoes from exclusive farms in Ravounel, has a name - Supple.
Enjoy a glass of premium and refined flavor.
Savor the taste and aroma of the rich, earthy notes in each bottle, expertly crafted from the finest ingredients. Raise a glass of Supple, the epitome of luxury and refinement.

items.name: Cloak Of Elvenkind
items.description:
Description
These cloaks of famed elven design are enhanced to reflect the wearer's surroundings, aiding him in blending in with any terrain. When this plain gray cloak is worn with the hood drawn up around the head, the wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks.
Base Item: 
RequirementsCraft Wondrous Item, invisibility, creator must be an elf
Source: Ultimate Equipment

items.name: Potion of Freedom of Movement
items.description:
This spell enables you or a creature you touch to move and attack normally for the duration of the spell, even under the influence of magic that usually impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow, and web. All combat maneuver checks made to grapple the target automatically fail. The subject automatically succeeds on any combat maneuver checks and Escape Artist checks made to escape a grapple or a pin.

items.name: Ring of Protection +2
items.description:
Aura moderate abjuration; CL 6th

This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.

items.description: Crafted by the renowned perfumer Calvin Carpenter from the luxury brand from Kintargo in the opulent region of Ravounel, Essence of the Irresistible is an exquisite perfume that captivates the senses of both land and sea creatures. items.name: Boots of the Daredevil
items.description:
This pair of magical softpaw boots allows the wearer to gain extra maneuverability while moving through hazardous areas.

As a free action, the wearer can click her heels together to grant herself a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks made to move through threatened squares or to move through an enemy’s space without provoking attacks of opportunity for up to 10 rounds per day. items.name: Nutonia, Luxury Spread by Calvin Carpenter
items.description:
Nutonia, Luxury Spread by Calvin Carpenter
Smear refinement in paste-form across the bread of your life. Nutonia is a nut butter made from the sack of the most robust harvest of Taldania-nuts. Taste the nut of a generational-talent.
